message: 最初の３人

name: Soltia
message: 「He won't ever show his face again」

name: Azel
message: 「What?! Don't tell me you decided Pasta outlived his usefulness and--」

name: Soltia
message: 「How rude. Pasta fought Nibe and lost」

name: Azel
message: 「You... set him up, didn't you」

name: Soltia
message: 「I did not. Yesterday, when we ran an activation test on the magic circle, Nibe appeared and a battle broke out. And unfortunately, well」

name: Azel
message: 「Could that commotion yesterday have been」

name: Bylous
message: 「That's right」

name: Azel
message: 「What happened to the Demon called Nibe?」

name: Azel
message: 「What?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Subtlety is completely lost on this guy...」

name: Soltia
message: 「By the time I arrived, both of them had vanished」

name: Azel
message: 「Pasta...」

name: Bylous
message: 「With this, we're back to the original three」

name: Soltia
message: 「Indeed we are」

name: Bylous
message: 「It was right here, on that day, that we joined hands」

name: Soltia
message: 「For the sake of Re-Crea」

name: Azel
message: 「As our Lord wills it」

name: Bylous
message: 「None of us knew each other's true motives. We gathered solely for Re-Crea」

name: Soltia
message: 「It makes me a little sentimental. Honestly, I never thought we'd make it this far without stabbing each other in the back」

name: Azel
message: 「...Because our Lord desires Re-Crea」

name: Soltia
message: 「However, there are those who do not desire it」

name: Bylous
message: 「Now that the magic circle is complete, we defeat them. Is that how it is?」

name: Soltia
message: 「There's nothing to be surprised about, is there? We must crush any element that might interfere with Re-Crea, no matter how trivial」

name: Azel
message: 「...What is your opinion?」

name: Bylous
message: 「I have no objections」

name: Soltia
message: 「You wouldn't oppose this either, would you? Re-Crea is God's will, so anyone who does not wish for it is your enemy as well」

name: Azel
message: 「...Everything according to the Lord's will」
